summary: Diagnosed idempotency deduplication failure in background worker click persistence.
evidence: Identified root cause: click.worker.ts omitted eventId during prisma.clickEvent.create, inserting NULL and bypassing unique constraint deduplication.
Observed symptom: replaying duplicate click job payload resulted in status: success and duplicate database row instead of status: deduplicated.
Formulated diagnostic check: inspect worker persistence call and verify ClickEvent rows for NULL or missing eventId values.
